S1.text: 낯선 마트 주차장, 텅 빈 자리에 홀로 남겨진 열일곱 살 임산부.
S1.en: An unfamiliar store parking lot, and a pregnant seventeen-year-old left all alone by an empty space.

S3.text: 하지만 남자친구는 끝내 오지 않고, 남은 건 단돈 5달러 55센트.
S3.en: But her boyfriend never comes back, and all she has left is five dollars and fifty-five cents.

S4.text: 갈 곳 없는 소녀는 그날부터, 아무도 몰래 월마트에 숨어 사는데요.
S4.en: With nowhere to go, from that day on the girl secretly lives hidden inside the Walmart.

S5.text: 그리고 폭풍우 치던 어느 밤, 아무도 없는 매장 한가운데서 진통이 찾아옵니다.
S5.en: Then one stormy night, in the middle of the deserted store, labor pains hit.

S8.text: 하룻밤 새 꽃다발이 쏟아지는 유명 인사. 과연 이 어린 엄마 앞엔, 어떤 인생이 펼쳐질까요?
S8.en: Overnight she becomes a celebrity showered with bouquets. What kind of life awaits this young mother?

S9.text: 2000년 작, 웨어 더 하트 이즈. 결말까지 바로 시작합니다.
S9.en: From 2000, Where the Heart Is. Let's go all the way to the ending, starting now.

S99.text: 한편 윌리 잭은, 밤길에서 웬 소녀를 발견하는데요.
S99.en: Meanwhile, Willy Jack spots a girl by the road at night.

S103.text: 임신한 여자친구는 버리고, 히치하이커 소녀 졸렌은 냉큼 태웁니다.
S103.en: He dumped his pregnant girlfriend, yet eagerly picks up a hitchhiking girl, Jolene.

S106.text: 아기 침대 앞에서 한참을 떠나지 못하는 예비 엄마.
S106.en: A mother-to-be who can't tear herself away from the baby cribs.

S107.text: 파라솔 아래 초콜릿 우유, 한밤의 나 홀로 피크닉.
S107.en: Chocolate milk under a patio umbrella: a midnight picnic for one.

S109.text: 그 사이 윌리 잭은, 지갑을 털렸다며 기름값 타령인데,
S109.en: Meanwhile Willy Jack keeps whining about gas money, claiming his wallet was stolen,

S111.text: 졸렌이 내민 돈에 입이 귀에 걸립니다.
S111.en: The money Jolene hands him puts a grin from ear to ear on his face.

S113.text: 난데없이 들이닥친 경찰이, 소녀의 나이를 묻는데,
S113.en: Out of nowhere the police show up and ask the girl how old she is,

S116.text: 매장 침낭에서 자고, 세면대에서 씻는 나날.
S116.en: Days of sleeping in a store sleeping bag and washing up at the sink.

S117.en: When day breaks, she hides away in the storeroom.

S119.en: A nail-biting game of hide-and-seek through the crack in the door.

S121.text: 몰래 빠져나와, 끼니는 공원 벤치에서 때웁니다.
S121.en: She sneaks out and makes do with meals on a park bench.

S123.text: 한편 윌리 잭은 철창 신세가 됐는데
S123.en: Meanwhile, Willy Jack has ended up behind bars, and

S125.text: 새벽 5시 반 기상. 직원들보다 한발 먼저 움직이죠.
S125.en: Up at 5:30 a.m., she always moves one step ahead of the staff.

S126.text: 쓴 물건은 꼬박꼬박 공책에. 이름하여 월마트에 갚을 빚.
S126.en: Everything she uses goes faithfully into a notebook, titled: what I owe Walmart.

S128.text: 행운의 마로니에가 시들자, 찾아간 곳은 도서관.
S128.en: When her lucky buckeye tree starts to wither, she heads to the library.

S132.en: This is Forney, the bookworm librarian.

S135.text: 보다 못해 책을 찾아다 펼쳐 줍니다.
S135.en: Unable to just watch, he fetches the book and opens it for her.

S138.text: 위층에서 난 소리에, 포니는 허둥지둥 계단을 오르는데요.
S138.en: At a noise from upstairs, Forney hurries up the stairs.

S143.text: 식사 기도 중, 시스터는 스프락 씨와 함께 잔 죄를 용서해 달라는데요.
S143.en: During grace, Sister asks the Lord to forgive her for sleeping with Mr. Sprock.

S146.text: 아직 월마트에 숨어 산다는 건 꽁꽁 비밀인데,
S146.en: That she is living hidden in Walmart is still a closely kept secret,

S148.text: 도서관 책대로, 마당 제일 높은 곳에 나무를 심는데,
S148.en: Following the library book, she plants the tree on the highest spot in the yard,

S153.en: But he never managed to finish college.

S155.text: 월마트로 향하는 뒷모습을 쫓는 포니의 눈길.
S155.en: Forney's eyes follow her as she walks back toward Walmart.

S156.text: 어느덧 몇 주 뒤, 폭우가 쏟아지는 밤.
S156.en: Weeks later, a night of pouring rain.

S158.text: 잠에서 깨 짐을 챙기다, 진통에 배를 움켜쥡니다.
S158.en: Waking up and packing her things, she clutches her belly as labor begins.

S160.text: 양수까지 터졌지만, 텅 빈 매장엔 도와줄 사람 하나 없습니다.
S160.en: Her water has broken, but there is no one in the empty store to help.

S162.en: After holding out as long as she can, she finally collapses to the floor.

S163.en: And of all places, aisle five, the number she can't stand.

S165.en: Then Forney crashes in through the window.

S166.en: Will mother and baby make it?

S167.text: 다행히 엄마도 딸도 무사합니다. 눈을 뜨니 병원 침대 위.
S167.en: Thankfully, mother and daughter are both fine. She wakes up in a hospital bed.

S169.en: The gentle touch of a warm-hearted nurse, Lexie.

S176.text: 돈 걱정도 잠시, 처음으로 품에 안아 보는 딸.
S176.en: Money worries forgotten for a moment: her daughter, in her arms for the first time.

S177.text: 그날 밤 아기를 받아 준 사람이 누구였는지, 렉시가 들려주는데,
S177.en: Lexie tells her who it was that delivered the baby that night,

S179.en: Her daughter's name: not Wendy, but Americus.

S182.text: 달달한 간식 이름의 네 남매, 렉시도 열다섯에 엄마가 됐죠.
S182.en: Four kids named after sweets: Lexie, too, became a mother at fifteen.

S185.text: 인터뷰가 전파를 타자, 전국에서 편지가 쏟아집니다.
S185.en: Once the interview airs, letters pour in from all over the country.

S187.text: 아기는 축복받지 못할 거라는, 미시시피에서 온 저주의 편지.
S187.en: A cursing letter from Mississippi, saying the baby will never be blessed.

S188.en: There are also warm letters with money tucked inside,

S190.text: 그때 불쑥 찾아온 친엄마 마마 릴.
S190.en: Then, out of the blue, her own mother, Mama Lil, shows up.

S192.text: 다섯 살 생일에 도망갔던 바로 그 엄마.
S192.en: The very mother who ran off on her fifth birthday.

S194.text: TV를 보고 열 시간을 달려왔다며, 담배부터 무는데요.
S194.en: Saying she drove ten hours after seeing her on TV, the first thing she does is light a cigarette.

S210.text: 셋이 살 집을 구하자는 뜻밖의 제안.
S210.en: An unexpected offer: find a home for the three of them, baby included.

S215.text: 돈을 합치자며 받아 든 500달러, 이 엄마 믿어도 될까요?
S215.en: She takes the $500, saying they should pool their money. Can this mother be trusted?
